subject: Vanguard HealthTech – postsign kickoff, owner map & initial asks
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>; Alicia Monroe <alicia.monroe@vanguardhealthtech.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@vanguardhealthtech.com>
Cc: procurement@vanguardhealthtech.com
Date: 2026-12-11T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Vanguard HealthTech – postsign kickoff, owner map & initial asks

Team / Alicia, Tom —

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround on signatures. Quick recap to get the internal handoff captured and aligned:

Deal summary
- ACV: $1.2M (annualized)
- Deal type: Dedicated + Private VPC (EU data residency for subset, US for others)
- Target go-live: 2027-02-28 (pilot in Jan, phased rollout in Feb)
- Primary use case: A/B personalization and real-time customer assistant for clinician workflows

Key constraints & technical notes (from discovery)
- SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning required; they manage identity in Okta (Alicia will share admin contact).
- SOC 2 evidence required prior to dedicated provisioning; they requested audit-window for SOC 2 report.
- Data residency split: PHI-like telemetry stored in US; aggregate analytics in EU region.
- Network: we'll deploy into their VPC with customer-managed NAT; they want an architecture review call before onboarding.

Attachments: VHT_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW + acceptance criteria), VHT_Solution_Architecture_v2.pptx, vht-poc-notes.md

Proposed internal owners (please ack or propose alternates):
- Primary CS Owner: Ben Carter (customer success lead)
- Implementation PM: Tessa Morgan (program manager, sprints + runbook)
- Technical lead / Staging liaison: Laura Bennett (infra & preflight)
- Sales exec sponsor: Karthik Iyer (escalation/contact for terms)

Alicia / Tom — please confirm SAML admin contact and procurement timing (PO / EOR / legal redlines). If procurement is on a different timeline we should mark any gating items.

Next steps (internal)
1) Ben/Tessa: schedule 60m kickoff with VHT and invite engineering + security for architecture review (target this week).
2) Laura: prep staging bucket and preflight checklist (I can share the template).
3) Karthik: confirm any SLA exceptions that were agreed in the deal desk (if so we add to the SOW).

Thanks — I’ll leave the calendar scheduling to Ben/Tessa once you confirm availability.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Attachments: VHT_SOW_v1.pdf, VHT_Solution_Architecture_v2.pptx, vht-poc-notes.md

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@vanguardhealthtech.com>, procurement@vanguardhealthtech.com
Date: 2026-12-11T09:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vanguard HealthTech – postsign kickoff, owner map & initial asks

Thanks Priya — putting my hand up as primary CS owner. A couple of immediate questions I want captured before the kickoff:

1) Integration surface: is there a requirement to send raw clinician conversations to VHT analytics or will we only deliver de-identified aggregates? The SOW mentions "telemetry" but I want explicit acceptance criteria.
2) Okta contacts — Alicia, can you share name/email of the admin who can create an integration app and test users for SCIM?
3) Procurement gating: Tom / procurement — what's the expected PO issuance date? We need that for provisioning the Dedicated pool.

Proposed kickoff window: Thu 12/16 or Fri 12/17, 10:00–11:00 PT (I’ll spin up the calendar once we get a green light).

I'll also pull our staging runbook and post a short preflight checklist to the kickoff invite so engineering knows what to expect.

Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-12-11T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vanguard HealthTech – postsign kickoff, owner map & initial asks

Hi all — thanks Priya and Ben. Quick answers from our side:

- Okta admin: Rebecca Chen (rebecca.chen@vanguardhealthtech.com); she owns the identity integrations and will stand up the test connector.
- Telemetry: for phase 1 we will only accept de-identified telemetry into the EU analytics environment. We can revisit for expanded pilot if needed in phase 2.
- Procurement: procurement@vanguardhealthtech.com is tracking PO issuance; our internal target is 12/20, but we expect legal may have 2–3 small redlines on the SOW (mostly around indemnity language).

We confirm the proposed kickoff window on 12/16 10–11 PT works for our team. Please send calendar invite; we’ll have security and Okta reps join the architecture review.

Alicia Monroe
Director, Product Ops | Vanguard HealthTech
alicia.monroe@vanguardhealthtech.com

Attachments referenced: none (we reviewed the SOW).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-11T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vanguard HealthTech – postsign kickoff, owner map & initial asks

Appreciate the speedy alignment. Two quick notes from the deal side: 

- Deal ID D-58201-VHT matches our records; committed start-of-service is 2027-01-03 for pilot usage. Full dedicated provisioning to follow once PO clears (Ben — provision window is typically 7–10 business days after PO).
- There is a 10% one-time onboarding credit included that we flagged in the SOW; legal may ask to move the language into an Appendix — just an FYI in case we see redlines.

I’ll stand by on the kickoff and will join the architecture review to cover contract items. If procurement needs any pricing clarifications I can jump on a call with Tom.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
